thread:
Ken: Heads-up from an SI call: partners want a clear CI-friendly adapter + test harness for the upcoming auth header change. Can we outline what we’ll provide?
Maya: Yeah, we should offer a repo + a small Dockerized test runner they can drop into their CI. Also a one-page checklist.
Oliver: Agreed. Technical plan: new header is Authorization-V2: Bearer <token>. We'll accept legacy Authorization: during grace. Will expose an opt-in compat flag too.
Sara: Marketplace QA asked whether signed artifacts are mandatory for listing or just the runtime smoke tests.
Ken: Marketplace requires runtime smoke + packaging manifest (yaml) and a checksum. Signing is recommended but not mandatory for first pass.
Tim: From support need: a troubleshooting playbook and a temporary proxy fallback so partners can route through our compat layer if they hit time constraints.
Oliver: I'll prepare a small reference adapter repo (node + python) with tests: adapter-ci (unit), runtime-smoke (end-to-end against staging), telemetry-check (ensures partner tag present).
Maya: Proposal for deprecation windows: 90-day announce -> 90-day soft deprec where legacy still accepted -> 180-day opt-in compat header before we turn off. Thoughts?
Ken: That seems long but safer. For marketplace partners we can offer an extended bridge if they sign a comms SLA.
cert-bot: checklist created: https://partners.redwood/cert/checklists/984321001 (items: adapter-reference, adapter-ci, runtime-smoke, packaging-manifest, telemetry-tagging)
Sara: I'll update the partner portal with a short FAQ and include the packaging manifest example. Sample manifest snippet:```yaml
name: partner-integration
version: 1.2.0
entrypoint: ./adapter/start.sh
compat_headers: [Authorization-V2]
```
Ken: Can eng add a telemetry tag so we can measure partner-specific failures? e.g., partner_compat_shift and partner_id in logs.
Oliver: Yes, will add header echo and error tagging. Also add a Console dashboard tile for partner regressions.
Tim: On-call: recommend 24/7 rotation for weeks 2-3 of canaries. Support + Eng + Cert on the roster.
Maya: Comms plan: targeted emails to top-12 SIs, marketplace notice, and an in-console banner. I'll draft the email and post for review.
cert-bot: canary schedule created: week2: Partner-Redline, week3: Partner-Gamma, week4: Partner-Atlas. Auto-rollback rule: sustained error rate >1.2% over 10m triggers rollback.
Oliver: For the adapter repo I'll include a Docker image with a test runner: run.sh will run adapter-ci then runtime-smoke against staging. Example:```bash
./run.sh --staging --token $TEST_TOKEN
```
Maya: Who owns publishing the reference repo under redwood org? Ken?
Ken: Eng owns it but Maya will own the README and comms. Oliver, please create and add a CODEOWNERS file.
Sara: Marketplace QA will need a checklist entry ensuring telemetry appears in logs and Console. I'll add cert-bot automation to verify telemetry tag.
Tim: Also add a partner helpline Slack alias for the canary window: #canary-partner-help.
Oliver: Will push initial repo later today and tag the canary PR.
Maya: Timeline draft: Day0: announce + repo + docs. Day7-21: partner canaries. Day30: open marketplace certification window. Day90: soft deprec start. Day180+: remove legacy.
Ken: Action items: Oliver=repo + telemetry; Sara=portal + packaging docs; Maya=comms + partner emails; Tim=on-call rota; cert-bot=automated checklist runs and canary gating.
Maya: I'll circulate the partner email draft in #partnerships for quick feedback. :thumbsup:
Ken: Great thread. Let's reconvene after first canary run and review metrics.
